english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Standard IELTS Academic 6.0 overall (minimum 5.5 in each component) or accepted equivalent if not previously taught in English; specific courses may require higher. No RHET 1020 waiver stated.

available_terms.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Manchester/Manchester Met Fact Sheet 2025-26.docx
available_terms.notes: Fact Sheet covers September-start (Fall), January-start (Spring), and Full Academic Year exchanges.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Semester 1: Welcome Week Sep 28 – Oct 2, 2026; Teaching Oct 5 – Dec 18, 2026; Winter Break Dec 19 – Jan 10, 2027; Assessment Jan 11 – Jan 22, 2027.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Semester Two: Future Me Week Jan 25 – Jan 29, 2027; Teaching Block 1 Feb 1 – Mar 19, 2027; Spring Break Mar 20 – Apr 11, 2027; Teaching Block 2 Apr 12 – May 7, 2027; Assessment May 10 – May 21, 2027.
spring_term_dates.notes: Manchester Met Fact Sheet 2025-26.docx notes 'January start for one semester only' and links to mmu.ac.uk term dates.

tuition_model.notes: Official mmu.ac.uk confirms incoming exchange students do not pay tuition fees or tuition fee deposits to Manchester Met.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: mmu.ac.uk (living-costs) states baseline components (>=£170/mo groceries/essentials, >=£80/mo private household bills/utilities, >=£12/mo mobile + variable rent) without publishing an official total monthly GBP range (third-party estimates excluded).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No official combined MMU monthly GBP living budget published (see UKVI visa financial requirement £1,171/month).

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Manchester/Manchester Met Fact Sheet 2025-26.docx
housing_availability.notes: Full-year and January-start students may apply for on-campus halls subject to availability (https://www2.mmu.ac.uk/accommodation/); September-start 1-semester students are assisted via Manchester Student Homes for short-term housing.

housing_notes.value: Full-year & Jan-start eligible to apply for on-campus accommodation (subject to availability); Sep-start 1-semester supported via Manchester Student Homes (https://www.manchesterstudenthomes.com/Accommodation) with details sent in offer letter.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Manchester/Manchester Met Fact Sheet 2025-26.docx

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: 1-semester (<6 months): enter under UK Visitor rules without ATAS. Full-year: UK Student Visa required; UKVI outside-London financial proof is £1,171/month (up to 9 months = £10,539 held for 28 consecutive days unless nationality differentiation applies); ATAS not required for exchange.

exchange_page_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Manchester/Manchester Met Fact Sheet 2025-26.docx

credit_system_and_load.value: UK / Manchester Met credits: 60 MMU credits (= 30 ECTS) per semester; 120 MMU credits (= 60 ECTS) per academic year; includes optional free Uniwide Language unit (7.5 ECTS/term).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Manchester/Manchester Met Fact Sheet 2025-26.docx

course_restrictions_note.value: Excluded majors per agreement: Acting, Architecture, Computing, Education, Engineering, Healthcare Science, Journalism, Maths, Sports Science.

international_support_services.value: Study Abroad Team holds 'Welcome to Manchester Met' session during Welcome Week plus department inductions and Manchester Student Homes short-term accommodation advising.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall: Nomination Apr 1, Application May 12; Spring: Nomination Oct 1, Application Oct 16.
